subject: Re: Security event notification — request for IRP, SOC 2 artifacts, and postmortem
messages:
From: Alice Wu <alice.wu@finbridge.com>
To: soojin.lee@redwood-inference.com
Cc: security+alerts@finbridge.com
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Suspicious S3 access pattern — request for IR plan and SOC 2 artifacts

Hi Soojin,

We observed an anomalous S3 access pattern in one of our integrations tied to Redwood-managed ingest earlier this week (details in the alert digest). At this stage we are treating this as a security event and need the following to satisfy our internal compliance and our regulator’s audit:

- A copy of Redwood’s incident response plan (IRP) that covers cloud storage and data exfiltration scenarios;
- Any SOC 2 evidence packets (system description, control-owner contact list, last test date);
- Answers to the SIG/CAIQ items relevant to logging, retention, and incident notification SLAs;
- Contact for an on-call escalation (phone + 24/7 pager or escalation email).

Can you confirm receipt and provide a secure place where we can pull the artifacts? We may need a redacted postmortem once you’ve completed your internal review. Our compliance deadline to have artifacts on file is next Tuesday (2026-08-18).

For context: we have no confirmed data loss on our side yet; this is a precautionary audit trigger from our InfoSec team. Please let me know the appropriate point of contact.

Thanks,
Alice Wu
Security Program Manager
FinBridge Financial
[Attachment: finbridge_alert_digest_20260814.json (json)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood-inference.com>
To: Alice Wu <alice.wu@finbridge.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood-inference.com, marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Suspicious S3 access pattern — request for IR plan and SOC 2 artifacts

Alice — thanks for the heads up and for the alert digest. I’ve opened a short incident channel internally and copied our compliance and legal leads (Neha and Marcus).

Immediate next steps from Redwood:
- Confirm scope (we are correlating logs now and will send a scope summary within 3 hours).
- Share a secure artifact bundle (redwood SOC 2 system description, control-owner list, SIG/CAIQ responses) via an encrypted Drive link.
- Provide our IRP excerpt for storage/exfiltration scenarios and a point of contact for escalation.

Per your deadline, we will prioritize the artifacts and provide an interim evidence bundle by EOD Monday (2026-08-17). We will provide a redacted postmortem when the internal review completes (expected by Monday but may extend to Tuesday).

Temporary escalation contact: Soojin Lee (security lead) — soojin.lee@redwood-inference.com, +1 (415) 555-0198 (email preferred); on-call escalation: security-oncall@redwood-inference.com (this routes to our 24/7 pager).

I’m attaching an initial SOC 2 evidence package that contains the system description and control-owner contacts. It is an interim bundle; Neha will review for redaction prior to final delivery.

We’ll keep you updated every time we have a material change.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: soc2_initial_evidence_packet_v1.zip (zip)]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood-inference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Suspicious S3 access pattern — request for IR plan and SOC 2 artifacts

Soojin — quick coordination notes (internal):

- I reviewed the SOC 2 packet attached. We need to redact internal IP addresses in the control-owner logs and any ephemeral API keys before sending externally.
- Marissa: can you pull the runbook excerpt for storage-related IR steps (detection, containment, forensics, notification) and highlight any vendor-managed steps we need to disclose? I’ll draft a short redaction checklist.
- Marcus: will need a one-paragraph legal-safe summary for the postmortem that we can publish to customers (no admissions of fault).

Meeting suggestion: 30-minute sync at 13:00 PDT to finalize what can go out to FinBridge before Monday EOD.

-Neha
Director, Trust & Security
Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood-inference.com>
To: Alice Wu <alice.wu@finbridge.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood-inference.com, marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com, marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 15:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Suspicious S3 access pattern — request for IR plan and SOC 2 artifacts

Alice — thank you for patience while we completed a rapid internal review. Please find the interim materials linked below and attached.

Summary (high level):
- Timeline: detection window 2026-08-13 22:00 UTC — confirmed anomalous access pattern; containment actions taken 2026-08-14 01:10 UTC.
- Impact: No customer data exfiltration confirmed. A small subset of internal telemetry files were accessed; none contained PII or customer model data per current forensics.
- Root cause (preliminary): misconfigured bucket ACL combined with an opportunistic crawl from a third-party scanner. We have corrected the ACL and added an automated monitoring rule to block similar patterns.

Artifacts provided (secure link + attachments):
- Redacted postmortem (attached): redacted_postmortem_finbridge_20260816.pdf
- SOC 2 evidence (redacted): soc2_initial_evidence_packet_v1.zip
- Excerpt of incident response plan (IRP) covering cloud storage/exfiltration (Drive link): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0A_example_secure_link
- SIG/CAIQ responses (excerpts included in the Drive folder).

We took the following mitigations immediately:
- Corrected S3 ACLs and revoked all related external tokens.
- Blocklist applied to the identified scanner IP ranges and signature-based detection added.
- Enhanced alerting for storage access spikes and configured an automated snapshot + hashed index for forensic preservation.

If you need any additional technical artifacts (presigned log exports, full forensic timeline, or Sysdig captures) we can provide them through a signed NDA or customer evidence exchange portal — let me know your preference.

Next steps:
- We will hand over a final, fully redacted postmortem after the legal review (Marcus) and a final SIG/CAIQ pack with line-by-line responses by 2026-08-18 EOD per your request.

Please feel free to call if you want to triage live: +1 (415) 555-0198.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redacted_postmortem_finbridge_20260816.pdf (pdf)]
